# Changelog
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## v3.5.3
### Fixed
 - WoW Forever: fixed a Lua error (`attempt to concatenate field 'WOW_TOKEN'`) when opening the main window, as Forever has no WoW Token market. The WoW Token percentage row and option are now hidden on Forever

## v3.5.2
### Changed
 - Added WoW Forever support (interface version 16001)

### Fixed
 - WoW Forever is no longer detected as Classic Era: kill tracking, crafting results, WoW Token percentage and the addon compartment now use the modern code path

## v3.5.1
### Changed
 - Updated interface version to 120105

### Fixed
 - Use `C_Item.GetItemInfo`, `C_Item.GetItemCount` and `C_Item.GetItemQualityColor` instead of the removed globals
 - Use `C_CurrencyInfo.GetCoinTextureString` instead of the removed global (fixes errors when selling gray items)
 - Use `C_ChatInfo.SendChatMessage` and `C_CombatLog.GetCurrentEventInfo` instead of the deprecated globals

## v3.5.0
### Changed
 - Updated Ace3 libraries (AceGUI checkbox desaturation and slider text fixes)
 - Updated LibDBIcon-1.0 to r56, LibSharedMedia-3.0 to 12.0.0 and LibToast-1.0 to r16
 - Updated AceGUI-3.0-SharedMediaWidgets to 9004 (BackdropTemplate fixes)
 - Embedded libraries are now fetched at build time via .pkgmeta externals

### Removed
 - Removed unused duplicate libraries bundled inside AceGUI-3.0-SharedMediaWidgets

## v3.4.4
### Changed
 - Fixed silent auto start issue

## v3.4.3
### Changed
 - Fixed silent auto start issue
 - Updated interface versions

## v3.4.2
### Changed
 - Updated anniversary interface version

## v3.4.1
### Changed
 - Updated interface version

## v3.4.0
 - Update Ace3 addons
 - Bump interface version

## v3.3.4
 - Fix UI opening on vendor sell

## v3.3.3
 - Sanitized remaining loot messages

## v3.3.2
 - Fix group loot parsing
 - Fixed instance reset parsing

## v3.3.1
 - Handle secret value chat message better
 - Add no sound option to threshold

## v3.3.0
 - Made UI resizeable
 - Added font size
 - Made toasts moveable
 - Fixed loot group price source bug
 - Threshold triggers now not on itemPrice but itemPrice * quantity
 - Fixed backdrop border color error
 - Fixed luacheck errors

## v3.2.2
 - Change minimap icon so it also works with WoW Classic

## v3.2.1
 - Switched session export from CSV to JSON
 - Added looted items to export

## v3.2.0
 - Fixed in dungeon/raid issue with kill tracker

## v3.1.3
 - Improve AoE farm kill tracking for retail (better but not perfect)

## v3.1.2
 - Reenable kill track for retail. (Does only work for single mob kills right now)

## v3.1.1
 - Fix addon error in midnight (remove kill track)

## v3.1.0
 - Added kill tracker to the session history
 - Fixed version shown

## v3.0.0
 - Added session history (track, rename, export, etc.)
 - Fixed classic issues with not existing functions

## v2.3.12
 - Improve pkgmeta and release workflow

## v2.3.11
 - Added interface version for classic, anniversary, etc.

## v2.3.10
 - Fixed option toggle

## v2.3.9
 - Updated interface version

## v2.3.8
 - Add WOW Interface upload
 - Updated interface version
 - Updated Main UI Frame name to LAMainFrame in the global variables

## v2.3.7
 - Addon compartment added

## v2.3.6
- Fixed error when location is unknown like at the start of a delve or in the ethereal portal room

## v2.3.5
- Improved resilience, thanks to Brrserker

## v2.3.4
- Fixed typo

## v2.3.3
- Fixed price loading

## v2.3.2
- Fixed price loading

## v2.3.1
- Improved fetching token price and added automatic update on the token price

- Added support to track trade skills, like pilfering, prospecting and in general crafts, it is disabled by default, can be enabled in the options
- Added wow token farmed %, it is disabled by default, can be enabled in the options

## v2.2.14
